page.overview:
Who is Jenny Barnes?

Guinevere "Jenny" Barnes, the Dilettante, is a fictional character created by Chaosium for the first edition of the Arkham Horror cooperative board game. Her character has since been extensively expanded on by Fantasy Flight Games after they acquired the Arkham Horror franchise, appearing in both game expansions and Arkham Horror Fiction releases.

A strikingly attractive woman, Jenny is independently wealthy due to a generous allowance given to her by her father, a professor of Arthurian studies. It was as result of her father's vocation that she was named Guinevere, which she dislikes intensely, choosing to be known as Jenny. She prefers to dress in clothes which are the height of fashion, appears to be very up to date with cultural trends, and carries a pair of nickel-plated .45 automatic pistols. She is well-educated, likely as a result of her upbringing and her travels through Europe (: Hour of the Huntress).

During the Roaring Twenties, Jenny spent a long period attempting to help her sister Izzie overcome mental health problems for which she was committed. Finally, after experiencing burnout from her efforts - which she believed were her parents responsibility - she took the plunge and moved to Paris, desperate to start living her own life. Unfortunately, this caused a rift between the sisters, with Izzie believing that her sibling had abandoned her. With time this breakdown began to be repaired, and Jenny and Izzie's correspondence increased as the two embarked on the long process of reforging their former bond (: Hour of the Huntress).

When Izzie disappeared in the New England town of Arkham, Jenny made her way to Massachusetts in search of the missing woman. There, she discovered that Izzie had first been manipulated into joining, then coerced into assisting, a cult dedicated to the worship of the Outer God Shub-Niggurath. With the assistance of a ragtag group of allies, including tomboy mechanic Lonnie Ritter, Miskatonic University professor Tilde Félix, and Arkham PD officer Galeas Morgan, she managed to thwart the cult's efforts to summon a Dark Young, although the High Priestess was able to make her escape with Izzie as a hostage (: Hour of the Huntress).
